0022600147.text: The Trail Blazers (3-1) are 2nd in the Northwest, half a game back, and 4th in the West, with a 2-0 road record and a loss in their most recent game. The Jazz (1-4) are 5th in the Northwest, three games back, and 12th in the West, having lost three straight. Portland is missing Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness), Ja Morant (hamstring), and Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Robert Williams III is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision; Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), and Lauri Markkanen is day-to-day with a wrist injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Trail Blazers won the season series 4-0, including a 124-114 win in Portland on March 13, 2026.
